wizard.title: Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) & Enforcement
wizard.subtitle: Multi-step regulatory filing with optimistic state synchronization

step1.freezeAndSarDesc: Blocks outgoing card/wire transfers and submits FinCEN SAR filing.
step1.sarOnlyDesc: Submits regulatory report without alerting the account holder.
step1.confirmEvidence: I confirm that the telemetry timestamps, IP origin, and risk score factors have been verified.

step2.compromisedVectorPlaceholder: e.g., Credential stuffing via unverified mobile ASN
step2.notesPlaceholder: Provide objective forensic details supporting this SAR filing (minimum 15 characters)...

step3.amlVerified: AML / BSA threshold rules evaluated against transaction history.
step3.kycCrossChecked: Account holder KYC identity document verified against device metadata.
step3.chainOfCustody: Digital evidence hash preserved in immutable compliance storage.

step4.signaturePlaceholder: Type your full name to authorize filing

feedback.optimisticSuccess: SAR filed and transaction status updated.
feedback.rollbackError: Filing failed ({reason}). Optimistic UI changes have been safely rolled back.

validation.evidenceRequired: You must verify the telemetry evidence before proceeding.
validation.distanceRequired: Enter a valid distance in kilometers for impossible travel cases.
validation.vectorRequired: Specify the suspected compromise vector (min 5 characters).
validation.notesMin: Investigator narrative must be at least 15 characters.
validation.checklistRequired: All three regulatory compliance attestations must be checked.
validation.signatureMin: Digital signature must be at least 3 characters.
